purpose: Score-level fusion remnant of E163: the full feature-concat grid already completed in run.log without any diagnostic-AUC gain, but the process was killed before the score-fusion stage could be written to results.json. This config re-runs the same verbatim E143 protocol with a reduced concat grid so the score-fusion verdict is persisted without recomputing 72 concat evaluations.

E65_logspd.note: 855-d correlation log-SPD vector, the E143 representation

E162_raw_eeg.note: 256-d embedding of the best E162 config (lambda=0.0, t=0.1)

standardisation.rule: per stream, task-wise z-score with Train-session1 statistics only (all Train rows of that task), identical to E143/E162 so the controls reproduce exactly
standardisation.sensitivity: the E65 control is re-run with fit-rows-only statistics (frac <= 0.6)

variants.raw: concat(E65 PCA, E162 PCA) then joint PCA

score_fusion.selection_metric: Train LOSO AUC of the fused z-score; Test is never consulted
score_fusion.z_normalisation: each stream score z-scored with its own 5-block Train OOF mean/std before weighting

E159_ceiling.note: single-score threshold tuning ceiling on E143 is W = 0.7352

protocol.prototypes: k-means (E143 seeding, 20 iters) per (task, identity) on fit_rows only
protocol.train_oof: 5 contiguous frac blocks, prototypes rebuilt without the held block
protocol.threshold: quantile of the 5-block Train OOF score at each acceptance rate
protocol.test: scored only; session used only for the post-hoc diagnostic AUC

reporting.test_official: N/A: the Test split has no public labels
reporting.headline_working_point: W at the reference acceptance 0.90 plus the grid-selected best W, reported separately
